To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed chimeric promoters from the full-length and subgenomic transcript promoters of FMV and identified a promoter with enhanced activity in the root vascular tissue of Nicotiana benthamiana.
the FS3-UAS promoter can be used for efficient gene expression in plant vascular tissues.

The chimeric promoters FS3-UAS and FS3-UAS-X3, derived from the full-length and subgenomic transcripts promoters of FMV, are more efficient and show higher expression in the root vascular tissue compared with the native promoters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new and efficient promoters for gene expression in plants.
the development of efficient chimeric promoters for plant genetic engineering.
the identification and development of a chimeric Figwort mosaic virus promoter that can be used for the efficient expression of foreign genes in plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FS3-UAS promoter could be efficiently utilized in the field of biotechnology.
the FS3-UAS3X is an efficient promoter in root vascular tissue and could be used in the future for gene delivery into root vascular tissues of plants.
the FS3-UAS chimeric promoter is the most efficient promoter for gene expression in root vascular tissue of Nicotiana benthamiana.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new promoter, FS3, that has a strong activity in the vascular tissue of roots.
, in the present study, we have successfully developed and validated a chimeric promoter for the root vascular tissue specific expression of transgenes in Nicotiana benthamiana plants.

the addition of multiple copies of FS3-UAS to the TATA-containing core promoter of FS3 results in a chimeric promoter that is 3-fold more active than FS3 promoter and can be used in plant transformation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
chimeric promoters can be used to enhance gene expression in plant vascular tissue.
the FS3-UAS can be used to generate chimeric promoters for enhanced activity.
the FS3-UAS promoter could be a useful tool to drive the expression of foreign genes in plants.
